Oneliner

Demonstrate CubeSat platform technologies for asteroid prospecting missions.
Description

Precursor mission for low-Earth orbit with the intent of flight-demonstrating several key Prospector-1 technologies. Demonstrate key subsystems of Prospector-1, notably power system, CDHS, tracking, telemetry and command system, optical navigation, water-based propulsion system and one of its key science payloads.
